text_block_list.text: A group of teachers had gathered, practically packing the classroom, so I curiously peeked inside---
And right in the center of it was Gold Ship!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Come on, do I really
have to write an apology essay~...?

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
It is NOT okay!
Not after you covered your homeroom teacher in chalk!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I was in the middle of measuring how far chalk dust flies, so the teacher who walked into the classroom is also at fault here!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: "...Understood. It seems you haven't reflected on your actions at all, so I'm adding one more reflection essay!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaaah~... Are you serious!?
Come on, that's not fair~...!

"She only had herself to blame for this.
Afterward, Gold Ship remained in low spirits for quite some time."
